characters.name: The Father
characters.prompt: A humble Norwegian peasant man from the 1400–1850 era, wearing simple woolen and linen garments in earthy tones. He has a tired but kind face, slightly scruffy beard, and stands in a dense medieval Norwegian forest setting.

characters.name: The Mother
characters.prompt: A modest Norwegian peasant woman from the 1400–1850 era, dressed in a plain, time-worn dress with a simple headscarf. She looks gentle and caring, holding her newborn daughter in a rustic cottage.

characters.name: The Daughter
characters.prompt: A beautiful young girl growing into a graceful woman over time, initially seen in ragged peasant clothing which later transforms into more refined attire. From the 1400–1850 Norwegian countryside, she has a kind expression and soft features.

characters.name: Foster Mother (Virgin Mary)
characters.prompt: A serene, radiant woman dressed in regal but subtly traditional Norwegian-robes of the 1400–1850 era, glowing with an otherworldly grace. She carries an air of gentle authority and compassion.

characters.name: The Prince
characters.prompt: A handsome young Norwegian nobleman from the 1400–1850 era wearing richly embroidered garments in royal colors. He has a confident yet compassionate demeanor, often framed against the backdrop of a grand medieval castle.

characters.name: The Old Queen
characters.prompt: A stern, older Norwegian queen in intricately decorated medieval attire from the 1400–1850 period. She carries herself with regal authority, her expression initially suspicious but capable of softening over time.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a dramatic scene set in old Norway between 1400 and 1850. Show a rustic forest cottage at the edge of a tall pine forest. In the foreground, a humble peasant family—father, mother, and their newborn daughter—stand nervously near the cottage. Approaching them is a radiant, regal woman (the Foster Mother), dressed in flowing Norwegian robes, offering to be godmother. The atmosphere should be gently lit, evoking both mystery and warmth. Capture the idyllic sense of rural life in these olden days and the magical aura surrounding the Foster Mother’s appearance.
modernMainImagePrompt: Reimagine the tale in a contemporary Norwegian setting. Place the scene in a modern home on the outskirts of a small Norwegian town, with pine-covered hills in the distance. The father and mother wear casual modern clothing, cradling their newborn daughter. A stylish, confident woman (the Foster Mother) arrives in a sleek car to offer help. Instead of a distant medieval church, a modern church or hospital is visible down the street. The colors and details should showcase present-day Norway, blending everyday realism with the same air of wonder and compassion that defines the story.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a colorful, friendly cartoon scene for young children showing a cozy wooden house surrounded by tall, bright-green pine trees in old Norway. The smiling parents hold their giggling baby. A gentle, glowing fairy-like figure (the Foster Mother) floats nearby, ready to help. The style should be playful and sweet, with soft outlines and cheerful colors. The overall feeling is safe and full of kindness.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et levende og moderne norsk illustrasjonsbilde av historien. I et rolig skoglandskap med et lite trehus fra gammel tid, viser du foreldrene som stolt holder sin nyfødte datter. En vennlig og lysende kvinne (Fostermoren) kommer for å tilby dåp og god omsorg. Vis uttrykkene deres tydelig, med varme farger og enkel, moderne stil. Tidsperioden er 1400–1850, men bruk lette, ferske fargetoner og enkel norsk estetikk.
englishMainImagePrompt: Portray a vivid and detailed illustration of the folktale set in old Norwegian times (1400–1850). Show a rustic wooden cottage by a forest of towering pines. The humble parents, dressed in peasant attire, cradle their newborn, while a radiant Foster Mother (Virgin Mary) in magnificent clothing approaches gently. A sense of both awe and warmth fills the scene, reminiscent of a classic fairy tale. Maintain the story’s original atmosphere, focusing on the magical and emotional elements of the narrative.
